maya: Morning — I need short admin access to run a one-time pg export for a VPC compliance audit on prod-olap-02 (east-us). ~15–20m. Can I get a JIT sudo window? cc @jonah @trevor
jonah: @maya pls include exact command, list of excluded columns (PII), and ticket ref. need to confirm scope before granting.
trevor: infra +1 once sec signs off. will provide ephemeral bastion key.
maya: command I plan to run:
```pg_dump -h prod-olap-02.internal -U redwood_admin -n public --column-inserts --file=/tmp/audit_dump.sql```
I will exclude PII columns and only capture schema+sample rows. ticket INF-412. target window today, 20m.
lisa: security note: require session recording, JIT role, and that you list excluded columns here. also redact tokens in any logs.
maya: excluding: email, ssn, phone_number. after dump I'll gzip and upload to artifact store and then delete local copy.
jonah: provisional OK: issuing 20m JIT role if session logging enabled and keys auto-expire. must run within 2h. I'll open breakglass INF-412-A and tag sec-audit.
sec-bot: [automated] Access request INF-412-A created by maya. Pending approval...
jonah: approved. JIT role redwood/jit-admin issued for 20m, session logging ON, keys expire after 30m. INF-412-A. :white_check_mark: 
trevor: created temp bastion key at /tmp/jit_key and uploaded to session. connect with: `ssh -i /tmp/jit_key -J bastion@ssh.redwood int@prod-olap-02` maya pls confirm you can connect.
maya: connected, starting dump now. will run exclusion and immediate scrub before upload.
lisa: reminder: use redact flag in any logging tools and rotate any tokens touched. post final confirmation with ticket id when done.
maya: done — dump written to /tmp/audit_dump.sql.gz, PII columns excluded, uploaded to INF-412 artifacts, local file deleted, keys revoked. marking task complete. thanks.
sec-bot: [automated] Session ended for maya. JIT role revoked. Audit log AL-7890 attached to INF-412-A: https://tickets.redwood/INF-412-A/logs/AL-7890
